subject.title: fix: wire tailscale_authkey and set operator for serve mode

question: Should the installer automatically replace an existing non-openclaw Tailscale `OperatorUser` when Tailscale is already connected?
rationale: That choice changes local Tailscale administration and serve permissions on existing hosts, which is a security and compatibility policy call rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Preserve Existing Operator
options.body: Set `openclaw` as operator only when no operator is configured or it is already `openclaw`, and show an actionable manual/opt-in path when another operator exists.

options.title: Transfer Operator To OpenClaw
options.body: Allow the playbook to replace any existing operator, but document the upgrade impact and require live upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Split The Policy Surface
options.body: Land only the auth-key/BackendState fix now and leave operator transfer for a narrower maintainer-approved follow-up.

recommendation.title: Preserve Existing Operator
recommendation.body: Set `openclaw` as operator only when no operator is configured or it is already `openclaw`, and show an actionable manual/opt-in path when another operator exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Andy Lauppe has the clearest history on the scoped sudo/security boundary this PR changes.
